Senior Frontend Engineer (Vue)
Nimbus Retail, Remote (EU)

About the role
Nimbus Retail powers the storefronts of 400 independent shops. You will own the buyer-facing experience.

What you must bring
At least 5 years of professional frontend engineering experience.
Deep production experience with Vue and its ecosystem.
Strong TypeScript skills in large codebases.
State management experience with Pinia.

Nice to have
Component testing with Vitest.

What you will do
Own the storefront checkout experience end to end.
Pair with designers on the shared component library.
Mentor two mid-level engineers on the team.
